text:
mik: Heads-up: did a quick pass on mobile console layouts. Trying two approaches: 1) persistent bottom nav + fluid table strip, 2) collapsible left rail that becomes a floating FAB on tiny screens. Mock: https://img.redwood.local/mobile-density.png. Thoughts on density toggle vs automatic collapse?

ruth: I prefer automatic collapse to reduce settings noise, but add a small "Compact" toggle in the table header for power users. Default should favor readability (no cramped rows).

jon: For <420px, tables should switch to a card-stack view rather than forcing horizontal scroll. Card format allows inline actions and better tap targets. Keep table for >=420px with horizontal scroll and sticky header.

jon: Accessibility: card view must preserve semantic order for screen readers; each card should be a <section> with aria-labelledby pointing to the model name.

mik: Good call. Also noticed our current kebab menu disappears off-screen on very narrow widths. Could we move actions into an inline secondary row in card view?

ux-bot: automated check: touch target sizes flagged for 3 elements in mock (actions, pagination, filter chips). Recommend >=44px. Color contrast check passed for text, failed for muted icon on dark theme (ratio 2.9:1).

ruth: Gesture concern: implementing swipe nav between primary areas could conflict with horizontal table scroll. Suggest: only enable tab swipe when user is at leftmost scroll position, and add a two-finger swipe gesture for explicit tab change.

jon: Implementation sketch: CSS + JS hybrid. Use overflow-x:auto with pointer-events tuning during swipe detection. Example:```css
.table-scroll { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
.card { min-width: 320px; padding: 12px; }
```js
// detect two-finger swipe to change tabs
if (touches.length === 2) { // allow tab swipe }
```

alex: Copy nit: in compact list we show "idle" vs "stalled" statuses. Can we use verbs? "awaiting input" vs "execution paused" — more actionable.

mik: Agree on copy — also make sure badges are truncated with title attribute for tooltip on long names. On mobile long press should reveal full name.

ruth: Keyboard nav: add focusable scroll controls on either side of the table (previous/next) so keyboard-only users can pan horizontally. Visible focus ring required.

jon: Perf note: virtualization + card layout needs a different overscan strategy when switching layouts to avoid white flashes. Suggest pre-render small buffer of cards on switch.

ux-bot: regression check: suggested color #DDEAF8 for muted icon on dark theme to meet 4.5:1. Also flag: remember prefers-reduced-motion for nav reveal.

mik: Timeline: I'll refine mock with card interactions and focus states today. Ruth can bake copy choices and accessibility text. Jon can prototype scroll behavior and two-finger swipe next sprint.

alex: I'll update the product ticket with the new default breakpoints: card fallback <=420px, table with horizontal scroll 420-720px, sidebar -> bottom nav below 720px. Add acceptance checks for contrast, touch target, keyboard panning, reduced motion.

ruth: tiny UX ask: show an affordance (chevron) when a row is truncated to indicate more horizontal content — helps discoverability.

mik: Nice. We'll include that. Thanks team :rocket:
